diagnostic_evidence: Run42636373161/artifact13683890787: focused/captured/current camera ray hit site-0001 at the projected screen center; E selected that site but management was false afterward.
cause: BaseDemo.show_panel(Build) implicitly calls select_build_kind, which emits placement_started. Preview._begin_preview closes management. BaseDemo._select then cancels that unintended draft, leaving the actual selected site without visible controls.
decision_before_production_edits: Add an explicit start_build_preview argument to the existing show_panel API, defaulting true for existing acquisition/navigation callers. Existing-site selection and contextual building panel routing pass false. The same method cancels an old draft when inspecting without creating a new one. Keep the existing controls, construction owner, mouse/focus guards and canonical manager.
justification: The UI owner should distinguish navigation/inspection from an explicit state-changing acquisition command. This removes the unintended placement signal at its source instead of reopening the menu after conflicting callbacks, adding a new mode owner or weakening input checks.

planning_gap.preavailable_requirement: Original feature contract required E on an unfinished actual site to expose its existing Build controls.
planning_gap.omitted_assumption: The planned contextual selection path did not include show_panel's placement_started fanout and the resulting Preview._begin_preview management transition.
planning_gap.learning: Inspect emitted signals and state-changing side effects along navigation helpers as part of the existing graph review. This inherited feature/resume pilot did not catch that connection before the direct failure; do not claim planning prevented it.

acceptance: Rerun only the same permitted brief current-change convoy/grid/site-E/explicit-builder/cancel episode after changed-script parsing. Its existing site-E and builder assertions must pass without alternate targeting, re-opening fallback or relaxed limits. Preserve both failed receipts.
limits: No local engine, regression suite, additional scenario, polling, economic/gameplay change or FPS claim. Retain the engine-created supplier UID from prior evidence; future observers preserve it when already present.
